headline: Sarang Deshpande resigns as Quick Heal Technologies Company Secretary
hook: Company secretary departure scheduled for late 2026
summary: Quick Heal Technologies Limited has announced that Company Secretary Sarang Deshpande will step down from his position on or before October 27, 2026. The exchange filing details the upcoming departure but does not disclose the reason for his resignation or name a successor. For Indian retail investors, routine management changes of this nature at mid-cap IT and cybersecurity firms typically have minimal impact on daily stock performance or business operations.
whats_next: Appointment of a new Company Secretary before October 2026
why_it_matters: Routine back-office departure; no impact on share price.
